svg.text: mcring stage 0 — NO-SOLDER bench rig: XIAO ESP32S3 Sense (pre-soldered) in the Expansion Board Base
Everything plugs in: base socket, Grove cables, STEMMA QT, JST battery, male-male jumpers into the base's breakout headers. Firmware: pio run -e xiao_esp32s3_sense_base (-DMCRING_XIAO_BASE).
Colours: slate = Grove / QT cable · purple INT · dark-red BAT+ · black GND · red 3V3 · teal I²S · brown speaker · dashed = optional (speaker amp is the one part whose header holes still want pins).
Grove cable / Grove→STEMMA QT cable (I²C + 3V3 + GND)
LIS3DH INT → D8 / GPIO7 (optional; tap-wake env)
I²S to the optional amp (D7 BCLK, D6 LRC, D10 DIN)
Thick slate = a 4-conductor Grove cable drawn as one bundle.
I imu: LIS3DH ready at 0x18 (double click -> INT1 …)
I drv: DRV2605L ready (ERM) · autocal ok
batt=0mV(255%) — no divider on this rig
button = the base's own button (D1), beep = base buzzer
double-tap the LIS3DH board → hands-free ask
no INT jumper? taps still work (25 ms poll); the
ring then wakes from deep sleep on the button only
tap-to-wake: fit the INT jumper AND flash
Seeed Expansion Board Base for XIAO (103030356 / Adafruit 5033) — top view, USB-C up
all XIAO pins broken out on two female headers · 2 × Grove I²C · Grove UART · Grove A0/D0 · JST 2.0 LiPo + charger (460 mA max) · OLED · RTC · microSD · buzzer · button
CS = D2 → PIN_HAPTIC parked; SPI D8–D10
RESET button · SWD pads · 5 V servo header: unused
(the base's charge LED lights while the cell charges)
Sense board (B2B) expected on top — UNVERIFIED, see check 2: OV2640, PDM mic, its microSD unused
pins DOWN into the socket (check photo)
(the base's JST cell feeds the XIAO —
via 5V/VIN or BAT pads: not verified)
no UART Grove *device* here: D6/D7 = I²S
LiPo 1S ≥ 400 mAh, JST-PH plug, with PCM
Adafruit 3898 (400 mAh) / 1578 (500 mAh) — the base charges at
up to 460 mA, too fast for the 100 mAh ring cell (Adafruit 1570)
check red = + against the base silkscreen; a forum thread reports
reversed pigtails on early units — never force a mismatched plug
ERM coin motor factory-attached — zero joints
EN tied on-module → PIN_HAPTIC = -1 in this build
LRA feel returns at stage 1 (INEED LRA0825BC on the board)
(alt.: Adafruit 2305 DRV2605L QT — motor pads need solder)
Adafruit 2809 — I²C 0x18 (0x19 with the SDO jumper)
or SparkFun Micro LIS3DH Qwiic SEN-29529 (0x19)
WHO_AM_I 0x33 — firmware auto-detects LIS2DW12 / LIS3DH at boot
double click on X/Y/Z → INT1, latched until CLICK_SRC is read
tape it to a finger / a coin: a floating board taps itself
INT is a bare through-hole. Solderless options: a male jumper pin pushed
in at an angle (friction), a tapped-in hammer-header pin (Adafruit 3662),
an IC-hook clip — or skip it: the base build polls (no deep-sleep tap-wake)
other end: jumper into header hole D8; then flash the _tapwake env
its 7 header holes are NOT soldered:
+ female jumpers, or 5 joints at a makerspace, or defer
to stage 1 (amp is SMT on the board). Headphones need none of this.
Adafruit 3923: snip its PicoBlade plug, strip the leads
→ screw terminal · polarity irrelevant (PUI 10 mm = stage 1)
Grove UART socket → 'Grove to 4-pin male jumper' cable (Seeed 110990210): D7, D6, 3V3, GND in one plug;
which Grove pin is D6 and which D7 → base silkscreen; swap BCLK/LRC if there is no sound
Grove cable (in the kit's module box)
Grove UART pin D7 / GPIO44 → BCLK
Grove UART pin D6 / GPIO43 → LRC
Check before power-on (no iron, so no shorts to make — but still:)
1. XIAO seated the right way round (USB-C toward the base's USB end;
pin 1 / D0 at the base's D0 silkscreen) — reversed = dead board.
2. Sense board clicked on, FPC latched; header side UNVERIFIED: the §1.5
photo must not show the base PCB (camera must face away from it).
3. LiPo: red = + on the base's JST silkscreen. ≥ 400 mAh (charger 460 mA).
4. Grove Haptic Motor and Grove→QT cable in the two I²C sockets — NOT
in the UART or A0/D0 socket (UART pins are I²S D6/D7).
5. LIS3DH INT → D8 only (never 3V3/5V); optional (taps are polled) — with
6. microSD slot empty: its CS is D2 and its SPI shares D8/D9/D10.
7. Nothing on the 5V header pin. Amp VIN = 3V3 (never 5V); SD → VIN.
8. Speaker leads only in the amp's +/− terminal, never to GND/3V3.
9. First power from USB with the cell unplugged; then plug the cell:
the base's charge LED lights. Boot log lists 0x5A (drv) and 0x18/19 (imu).
11. Deep sleep with the Sense board and the base fitted is milliamps (OLED,
RTC, charger, no camera power gate) — the bench kit is not for sleep numbers.
12. Build with -e xiao_esp32s3_sense_base(_tapwake); the stock env still runs
but drives the ERM as an LRA (autocal FAILED) and toggles D2 = SD CS.
wire crossings without a dot are NOT connected · dashed = optional · generated by hardware/pcb/wiring_stage0_solderless.py
